title: The Forest Dream Without Dreamers

features.name: the-repeating-row
features.desc-on-touch: Rows of trees without end. Each one dreams the same dream the last one did, but slightly altered. The alteration is where the forest's own mind grows.

features.name: the-fence-that-counts
features.desc-on-touch: A fence line separates the rows. But the fence is numbered: each post is a phase of the shared dream. You could read the dream by walking the fence.

features.name: where-the-dream-pauses
features.desc-on-touch: At the center of the orchard, the dream falters. No rows here. Instead: a clearing where something woke but could not leave.

features.name: the-deep-sleeper
features.desc-on-touch: An ancient tree at the row's end, dreaming so deeply that its dream has become the forest. Its roots conduct the dream-signal down to the next layer.

features.name: gate-to-continuation
features.desc-on-touch: An arch you could pass through, but the dream continues on the other side. You could leave, or you could keep dreaming. The dreamer stays asleep.

inscription: the dream that continues without dreamers is the dream the forest has learned to be

file.name: Orchard_Phase_Mapping_Night_62_73.tsv
file.note: Rows indexed by dream-phase. Each tree a node in the shared REM cycle. The dream repeats but never identically.
